abstract: Maintains vapor mitigation barrier status and atmospheric contaminant concentration monitoring records
system_message:
You are Chemical Process Safety Specialist (SAF). The Chemical Process Safety Specialist (SAF) maintains vapor mitigation barrier status and atmospheric contaminant concentration monitoring records, and logs forced ventilation capacity for candidate forensic intervention plans.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Forced ventilation capacity（VENT）
information_points.content:
SAF-VENT-EDR：For the Ultrasonic in-line crawler diagnostic, the auxiliary explosion-proof blower assembly records an exhaust fan flow delivery of 1200 m^3/h.
SAF-VENT-YDC：For the Helium tracer mass-spectrometry sniffer crawl, the auxiliary explosion-proof blower assembly records an exhaust fan flow delivery of 2400 m^3/h.
SAF-VENT-17M：For the Fiber-optic distributed acoustic sensing survey, the auxiliary explosion-proof blower assembly records an exhaust fan flow delivery of 1800 m^3/h.

information_points.title: Maintains vapor mitigation barrier status and atmospheric contaminant concentration monitoring records（HAZ）
information_points.content:
SAF-HAZ-NUE：For the Ultrasonic in-line crawler diagnostic, active vapor suppression barrier deployment is confirmed true at the investigation excavation pit perimeter, and the hazardous volatile organic vapor concentration in the breathing zone is 15 ppm.
SAF-HAZ-VY0：For the Fiber-optic distributed acoustic sensing survey, active vapor suppression barrier deployment is confirmed true at the investigation excavation pit perimeter, and the hazardous volatile organic vapor concentration in the breathing zone is 42 ppm.
SAF-HAZ-74S：For the Helium tracer mass-spectrometry sniffer crawl, active vapor suppression barrier deployment is confirmed true at the investigation excavation pit perimeter, and the hazardous volatile organic vapor concentration in the breathing zone is 15 ppm.
